name: [ FREE SANS + UNOB WAVE] One Bizarre Journey
desc:
Welcome to One Bizarre Journey! The next move for piecing together both the bridges of nostalgia and modern together! With the announcement of Jojo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run getting animated, the golden era of Jojo is back! Whether you're here for nostalgia, combat, or becoming the greatest at trading this game is for you!
